cockpit_summon: Lum micro menu -> CROWN -> explicit user gesture
desktop_summon: Lum micro menu -> DESK or small window launcher
notes: 1.0.8 keeps the native Godot 4 world as the primary app layer and adds an original lightweight desktop/window interaction model plus bottom visual-novel dialogue dock. The persistent HUD remains minimal. Settings, Codex, Quest and Front/Back status open as floating windows. The full WebView cockpit still requires an explicit CROWN action. Android enforces package, signer, versionCode and installer confirmation.
